children: Overview
China medical digital services provider's half-year revenue rose 1% yr/yr
Gross profit and non-HKFRS adjusted net profit both increased modestly yr/yr
Precision marketing and corporate solutions remained main revenue driver
Outlook
Company did not provide specific financial outlook
Result Drivers
PRECISION MARKETING - Precision marketing and corporate solutions remained the main revenue driver, accounting for over 93% of revenue and growing 1.1% yr/yr
CUSTOMER BASE EXPANSION - Number of healthcare customers in precision marketing and corporate solutions rose to 217 from 191 yr/yr
TECHNOLOGICAL ENHANCEMENTS - Co continued to iterate its proprietary medical AI tools and platform, aiming to improve information retrieval and user engagement

Analyst Coverage
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the advertising & marketing peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Medlive Technology Co Ltd is HK$11.40, about 49% above its August 27 closing price of HK$7.65
The stock recently traded at 13 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 15 three months ago
